verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a software platform, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes Unit as a vendor-run platform reached through APIs, a dashboard, and a vendor-hosted sandbox (api.s.unit.sh), plus fully managed solutions. Nothing in the pack documents a deployable or self-hostable version of the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
